entity.name: Button
entity.summary: Button is an interactive component that allows the user to execute an action. Button comes in three distinct appearances: solid, bordered, and transparent. These styles provide greater choice and flexibility for establishing hierarchy and affordance within a UI. You can display a button with or without a text description or icon.
entity.why: To allow the user to execute an action, such as “submit”, “merge” or “upload”. Buttons are typically placed in components and contexts such as dialogs, cards and forms.
tradeoffs: When the primary action is to take the user to another page or window rather than to trigger a function. Instead, use Link.
